Theme

Latin word

hasta

hasta, hastae f.

noun, first declension

a spear, a lance; set up at a public sale, hence sub hastā, at auction

In this lexicon

  • spear

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Sen. 19: nec ēminus hastīs aut comminus gladiīs ūterētur (Lewis & Short); Liv. 23.38.7: comitibus eōrum sub hastā vēnditīs (Lewis & Short)
